title: list all funds
description: Verify that the API endpoint GET /funds returns a list of all funds with correct properties such as id, name, symbol, fundType, status, aum, and nav.

title: create a new fund
description: Test the POST /funds endpoint to create a new fund with valid input data and verify that the fund is created successfully with a 201 response.

title: submit xrpl transaction
description: Test the POST /xrpl/transaction endpoint to submit a valid XRPL transaction and verify that the transaction is processed correctly.

title: get account balance
description: Verify the GET /xrpl/balance endpoint returns the correct account balance for a given account query parameter.

title: create xaman payload
description: Test the POST /xaman/payload endpoint to create a Xaman payload with valid request data and verify the payload is generated correctly.

title: verify xaman signature
description: Test the POST /xaman/verify endpoint to verify a Xaman signature with valid input and confirm the verification result.

title: list investors
description: Verify the GET /investors endpoint returns a list of registered investors.

title: register new investor
description: Test the POST /investors endpoint to register a new investor with valid data and verify successful registration.

title: run compliance check
description: Test the POST /compliance/check endpoint to run a compliance check with valid input and verify the compliance results.

title: rebalance portfolio
description: Test the POST /portfolio/rebalance endpoint to rebalance a portfolio with valid request data and verify the portfolio is updated accordingly.
